messages:
Jordan (ACME): Hey team — noticed the console shows tokens/sec dropping to 0 and some negative spikes for our stream from ~03:10–03:18 UTC. Billing looks off too. Screenshot: https://example.com/ss.png
SupportBot: Thanks for the report, Jordan — tagging infra and metrics. Can you share customer/org id and any query you ran? :eyes:
Jordan (ACME): org=acme-corp, route=/v1/generate, we didn't change anything on our end. The dashboard has a long flat 0 window and then weird -12k tokens/sec for a minute.
Alex P: Looking at ingestion logs now. Any chance this correlates with the midnight checkpoint roll?
Maria L: Which pipeline? streaming-rollup or the new aggregator-v2? We had a deploy to aggregator-v2 03:05 UTC.
Sanjay R: I see a deploy at 03:04:58 by deploy-bot to aggregator-v2 (tag: metrics-agg-2026-03-15). Possible schema change. Pulling consumer offsets.
Alex P: Quick repro: curl -s "https://metrics.internal/redwood/streams/tokensec?org=acme-corp&route=/v1/generate&window=60" | jq .points[-10:]
Maria L: Logs show this sequence around 03:06:  
```
WARN: rollup-window-mismatch: incoming window=30, configured-window=60
INFO: consumer-checkpoint-reset partition=17 offset_old=9834 offset_new=0 reason=manual-checkpoint
ERROR: delta-negative delta=-12456 metric=tokens/sec partition=17 key=user-123
```
Jordan (ACME): That consumer-reset sounds suspect. We didn't request any resets.
Sanjay R: The reset was from the scheduled maintenance script (ops-scheduler) which tried to reassign partitions during the aggregator-v2 deploy. It didn't complete cleanly so offsets got set back for some partitions -> negative deltas when rollups compute delta = current - previous (previous higher than new current).
SupportBot: Summary: cause = checkpoint reset during deploy + window mismatch causing misaligned rollup calculations. Impact = temporary negative tokensec and zero windows; billing reports may show under/over charges for that minute.
Maria L: Immediate mitigation: clamp negative deltas to 0 at rollup layer and emit a repair event to trigger a backfill. I'll open a quick patch to add clamp and ship as hotfix.
Alex P: Also need an idempotent backfill job for affected partitions. I'll spin up a job to replay from last-good-checkpoint (offset 9834) -> target offsets. Will attach job id when running.
Jordan (ACME): Appreciate the fast turnaround. Any ETA on correcting billing artifacts?
Sanjay R: We will backfill metrics for the affected 03:05–03:20 window and re-run billing roll. Estimated 2–3 hours after backfill finishes for billing to regenerate. If urgent, we can issue a provisional credit.
SupportBot: Action items: [Maria] hotfix clamp to rollup (PR#2345), [Alex] backfill job (job-5567), [Sanjay] postmortem and ops-scheduler incident writeup, [Billing] hold auto-bill for acme-corp until backfill complete.
Alex P: Backfill started job-5567 at 03:32 UTC. Processing ~120k events, ETA ~90m. Logs: `job-5567: replay partition=17 from=0->9834`
Jordan (ACME): Thanks. Will we get a final confirmation once tokens/sec reappear normally?
Maria L: I'll post when hotfix is deployed and negative clamping is live. Hotfix deployed 04:10 UTC.
Alex P: Backfill job finished 04:45 UTC. Verified metrics for acme-corp look normal; no more negative deltas.
Sanjay R: Billing reprocessed for that window at 05:05 UTC. Reconciled; provisional credit applied to acme-corp invoice.
Jordan (ACME): Confirmed — dashboard shows normal tokensec now and billing credit reflected. Thank you all :pray:
OpsBot: Incident closed. Postmortem link: https://rwd.infra/incidents/2026-03-15-agg-v2-checkpoint-reset
SupportBot: If you see recurrence, please reopen this thread.
